reasons: The full text is pinned and hash-verified in a community mirror.
No independent official award list or official paper-display locator was found for this record.
Repository popularity and an 'excellent papers' folder name do not establish an award.

page_evidence.observation: The cover exposes school, team number, and member names.
The long abstract reports preprocessing, SVM, random forest, CNN, channel selection, semi-supervised learning, and sleep-stage classification by subproblem.
Channel-weight bar small multiples compare subjects before channel selection.
Training and test accuracy histories accompany the selected channel subset.
Semi-supervised alternatives are compared with repeated train/test curves and a selection table.
SVM accuracy is plotted against the training-sample ratio and paired with a confusion-matrix definition.
CNN code is embedded in the PDF but external data, environment, and weights are not packaged.

abstract_structure.observation: Use one paragraph per subproblem, naming data treatment, candidate algorithms, selected method, and output.

model_chain.observation: Filter, segment, shuffle, and augment EEG samples.
Compare SVM, random forest, and CNN for target recognition.
Use convolutional weights to rank and select EEG channels.
Compare label propagation and adaptive semi-supervised variants.
Use SVM and neural methods for sleep-stage prediction.

validation_chain.observation: Show separate training and test accuracy curves.
Compare candidate semi-supervised algorithms under a common selection table.
Vary the labeled-training ratio and report classification accuracy.

figures.lesson: Use one panel per subject to expose heterogeneous channel importance.
Plot generalization behavior rather than reporting final accuracy only.
Combine learning curves with the final selected output.
Tie accuracy to data availability before recommending the model.

code_links.note: No independently packaged source tree was paired with this exact PDF; embedded appendix fragments are not treated as reproducible code.

transferable_rules.rule: For a long multi-question abstract, keep a strict question-method-result rhythm.
Use subject-level small multiples when feature importance is heterogeneous.
Report performance sensitivity to labeled-data volume for learning models.

risks.risk: The cover leaks direct identifiers and is incompatible with anonymous submission.
Repeated learning curves use small labels and do not include uncertainty across seeds.
Embedded source fragments lack data, dependency, seed, and model-weight provenance.
The mirror label is not independently verified as an award record.

provenance.review_method: full-page render overview plus 4-7 high-resolution evidence-page visual checks and extracted-text review
